title: weaver settings
description: Weaver-wide preferences, the same for every project. See https://github.com/medilies/weaver/blob/main/docs/settings.md

selected-colour.description: The colour marking what is selected in the browser, the config form and the questions weave asks, its text black or white to stay readable: an ANSI colour number, 0-255, or "#rrggbb". Cyan (6) unless set.

keys.description: The config form's keys on the drawing, tmux's unless set. None may be a key the config form already uses (arrows, h/j/k/l, enter, o, d, J, K, u, ctrl+r, ctrl+s, esc, ctrl+c), nor two the same.

split-right.description: Split the selected pane, the new one on the right. % unless set.

split-below.description: Split the selected pane, the new one below. " unless set.

remove.description: Remove the selected pane. x unless set.

shrink.description: Make the selected pane smaller. H unless set.

grow.description: Make the selected pane larger. L unless set.

key.description: A key as the terminal sends it: a character such as | or -, or a name such as space, f5, ctrl+x or alt+s.
